title: Powerbuilding: Tucker Loken (2016)
author: Mithosphere
desc:
INTRODUCTION
Tucker Loken's Powerbuilding program eliminates the choice between being strong and looking good. Designed for athletes who want a functional, powerful physique, this routine bridges the gap between powerlifting and bodybuilding. Instead of just chasing "pump" metrics, a powerbuilder focuses on technical proficiency in the Big Three lifts (Squat, Bench Press, and Deadlift) to establish baseline raw strength, while integrating classic bodybuilding strategies to forge broad shoulders, a tight waist, and dense muscle thickness.

TRAINING PRINCIPLES
+ The Powerlifting Foundation: You will start every major session with a primary compound movement (Squat, Bench, or Deadlift). You will pyramid the weights up over progressive sets, ramping up the intensity while leaving about 1 to 2 reps in the tank to avoid premature central nervous system exhaustion.
+ The Hypertrophy Finish: Once the heavy strength work is handled, the session shifts seamlessly into targeted bodybuilding training. Here, you will push the boundaries of muscle growth, culminating in taking the final set of your hypertrophy movements to absolute failure.
+ Strategic Fatigue Management: To bypass traditional plateaus and avoid joint wear, the program implements structured, regular deload weeks. During a deload, you drop the weight on your compound lifts to 50% of your max to refine form, pump nutrient-rich blood to the muscles, and completely recharge your nervous system.

THE 4-DAY TRAINING LAYOUT
The program cycles through a monthly intensity progression (e.g., Week 1: 5x6 reps, Week 2: 4x4 reps, Week 3: 3x2 reps, Week 4: Deload) across a 4-day split:
+ Monday: Bench & Chest
- Strength: Flat Barbell Bench Press & Close-Grip Bench Press.
- Hypertrophy: Incline Dumbbell Press, Machine Presses, Dips, and Pec Flyes.
+ Tuesday: Deadlift, Back & Biceps
- Strength: Conventional Deadlift & Deficit Deadlift.
- Hypertrophy: Lat Pulldowns/Pullups, Dumbbell Rows, Machine Rows, Barbell Curls, and Hammer Curls.
+ Thursday: Overhead Press, Shoulders & Triceps
- Strength/Hypertrophy Mainstay: Standing Overhead Press.
- Hypertrophy: Dumbbell Side & Bentover Laterals, Face Pulls, Shrugs, Skullcrushers, and Cable Pushdowns.
+ Friday: Squat & Legs
- Strength: Barbell Back Squat & Pause Front Squat.
- Hypertrophy: Leg Presses, Extensions, Leg Curls, and Lunges.

PROGRESSION TIMELINE
Run the baseline blocks back-to-back across two full 4-week cycles (8 weeks total), aiming to beat your previous weight milestones. In Week 9, test your heavy threshold with a top set of 2 reps for the Big Three. Finally, clear the runway for Week 10 to safely test and conquer your new one-rep maxes.
